source_meta._title: Some water in caves will not start flowing

stor.environment: Minecraft Java Edition snapshot 21w06a in a newly created single-player world using the Default world type and seed 4876135133240268742. Commands must be enabled. Creative mode is used only as a practical execution aid because the report does not specify a game mode.
preconditions: Launch the exact affected snapshot 21w06a, not a fix version such as 1.18 Pre-release 1 or 1.18 Pre-release 3.
Use a newly generated world rather than an existing or converted world.
Enter the seed exactly as 4876135133240268742, including all digits and without spaces.
Keep the world type set to Default.
Enable commands by selecting Creative mode or turning Allow Cheats on before creating the world.
Do not place, remove, or interact with blocks near the destination water before handing control to the observation subsystem, because a block update can change the fluid state being tested.

steps.action: In the Minecraft Launcher, select or create a Java Edition installation for snapshot 21w06a and start the game with that installation.
steps.success_cue: The Minecraft main menu is open and identifies the running version as 21w06a.

steps.action: Select Singleplayer, then select Create New World to open the world-creation screen.
steps.success_cue: The Create New World configuration screen is displayed.

steps.action: Set Game Mode to Creative. This is not a reported bug requirement; it is used to provide command permission and prevent survival hazards from interfering after teleportation.
steps.success_cue: The world-creation screen shows Game Mode: Creative.

steps.action: Open More World Options and enter the report's seed in the seed field exactly as supplied.
In More World Options, verify that the world type is Default. If another type is selected, cycle the World Type control until Default is shown.
steps.success_cue: The world-creation screen shows World Type: Default.

steps.action: Verify that Allow Cheats is ON. Creative mode normally enables commands, but explicitly confirm this setting if the screen exposes the option.
steps.success_cue: Commands will be permitted for the player in the new world.

steps.action: Select Create New World and wait for world generation and initial chunk loading to finish. Do not continue while a loading screen is present.
steps.success_cue: The player is in the newly generated Overworld, terrain is rendered, and movement and controls respond normally.

steps.action: Press T, or the currently bound Open Chat control, to open in-game chat.
steps.success_cue: The chat command input field is visible and ready for text entry.

steps.action: Enter the report's teleport command exactly, including the leading slash, and press Enter to execute it as the player. Do not replace, normalize, or round any command arguments.
steps.success_cue: The command executes, chat closes, and the player's view relocates to the underground Overworld destination near X=5990, Y=-22, Z=1164 with the command-specified viewing direction.

steps.action: After teleportation, remain still and wait until the destination cave and surrounding chunks are fully rendered. Do not break, place, or interact with any blocks, and do not touch the nearby water.
steps.success_cue: The cave terrain has stopped visibly loading, nearby surfaces and water are rendered, and normal camera/control response has resumed.

steps.action: Keep the camera at the orientation established by the teleport command and identify the cave water presented at the destination. Do not evaluate its behavior yet and do not cause a neighboring block update.
steps.success_cue: The destination cave water is visible while the player remains at the teleported location and has not interacted with the water or adjacent blocks.

stor.handoff_condition: The teleport command has loaded the player into the target cave, destination chunk loading is complete, the cave water is visible from the command-established position and orientation, and no block or fluid update has been caused near it. Hand control to the observation subsystem before any interaction with the water or adjacent blocks.
uncertainties: The report does not specify a game mode. Creative mode is selected only as a practical way to grant command permission and avoid survival hazards; it is not asserted to be necessary for the bug.

A February 19, 2021 comment states that the original seed and coordinates could no longer reproduce the issue at that time, while later comments reconfirmed the issue in 21w40a and 21w41a using a more precise form of the original coordinates. The plan nevertheless uses 21w06a because it is the first listed affected version and the original report was filed against the original seed and command.
The report describes the failure as occurring occasionally. This plan performs one safe trigger and does not repeatedly update the water or regenerate the world merely to amplify the issue.

The text does not describe the exact shape or position of the target water within the cave. The yaw and pitch included in the supplied teleport command are preserved because they appear intended to orient the player toward the relevant area.
The later 21w44a comment supplies a different seed and coordinate set, but that variant is not used because the required version-selection policy chooses the first listed affected version.
